test_manipulation_tasks: test all dm_control manipulation tasks run correctly with valid observations and rewards
validate_observation_spec: validate an observation dictionary matches its observation spec keys and array constraints
validate_reward_range: validate that a reward value is a float between 0 and 1
validate_discount_range: validate that a discount value is a float between 0 and 1
run_manipulation_episode: run a partial episode of a manipulation task with random actions within action spec bounds
